macros.name: abstract
macros.doc: Use the \abstract{...} command to include the disquisition abstract.

macros.name: acknowledgements
macros.doc: If the disquisition includes acknowledgements, include them using the \acknowledgements{...} command.

macros.name: appendix
macros.doc: If the appendix is not named, use the \appendix command to begin it.

macros.name: approvaldate
macros.doc: Use the \approvaldate{...} command to include the full date of disquisition approval (i.e. day, month, and year).

macros.name: approver
macros.doc: Use \approver{...} to include the department chair who approved the disquisition.

macros.name: cchair
macros.doc: The \cchair{...} command is used to indicate the committee chair.

macros.name: dedication
macros.doc: If the disquisition includes a dedication, include it using the \dedication{...} command.

macros.name: degreeoption
macros.doc: If the major department has a degree option, indicate this using the \degreeoption{...} command.

macros.name: department
macros.doc: Include the name of the major department using the \department{...} command.

macros.name: heading
macros.doc: Each \heading command starts a new page and entry in the table of contents.

macros.name: namedappendix
macros.doc: If the appendix is named, use the \namedappendix{...} command to begin it.

macros.name: title
macros.doc: Include the title of the disquisition using the \title{...} command.

envs.name: appendixfigure
envs.doc: If the appendix contains figures or tables, use the appendixfigure and appendixtable environments to generate them.
